services.name: Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Chasing the perfect Charleston sunset? Let our captains carry you to it, drink in hand, no planning required. Escape the crowds, leave the traffic behind, and step aboard Daniel Island Ferry for an unforgettable Charleston Sunset Harbor Cruise. Departing from the Daniel Island Waterfront, this relaxing 90-minute cruise takes you through the heart of Charleston Harbor as the sky transforms into brilliant shades of gold, orange, and pink. Whether you're visiting Charleston, planning a romantic date night, celebrating with friends, or simply looking for a peaceful evening on the water, our sunset cruise offers the perfect way to experience the beauty of the Lowcountry. services.desc: Want to see Charleston’s dolphins up close without chartering your own boat? Hop aboard and let a local captain take you right to them. Charleston Harbor is home to a resident population of bottlenose dolphins, and the Dolphin Watch Cruise puts you right out on the water where they feed and play. Departing from The Cooper Hotel Dock downtown, the cruise winds through the harbor with Charleston landmarks as a backdrop, keeping an eye out for dolphins the whole way. It’s family-friendly, laid-back, and one of the most popular ways to see Charleston from the water. 🐬 Resident Dolphins - Charleston Harbor’s bottlenose dolphins are frequently spotted feeding and playing. 🏛️ Historic Landmarks
